content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Morgan Swanson (E037)
Requested: write access to Payroll

Facts:
- Role: Engineer
- Employment type: contractor
- Security training: basic (not advanced)

Access policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

Morgan is a contractor with basic security training. So maximum is read (no advanced training). Requested write exceeds max, so grant the maximum = read.

The system is Payroll, owned by Payroll Specialist role. Morgan is Engineer, so no admin anyway.

Decision: read.
